## Profile

Mathematics graduate and university instructor with First Class Honours from
the University of Bristol, with final-year work in topological data analysis,
applied machine learning, and computational image analysis. Experienced in
Python, R, mathematical programming, and the development of university-level
teaching materials.

Earlier career experience spans public affairs, journalism, broadcasting,
technical writing, and strategic communications, including work in government,
national media, and digital publishing.

## Education

### BSc Mathematics

**[University of Bristol](https://www.bristol.ac.uk/){.cv-institution}**<br>
*Bristol, England, United Kingdom*<br>
September 2023–June 2026 · First Class Honours

Final-year work focused on topological data analysis, applied machine learning,
and computer vision. Selected marks included Mathematical Programming (94%),
Combinatorics (93%), Artificial Intelligence (92%), and Analysis (90%).

Final-year project: *Computational Stability of Cubical Homology: Orthogonal
Controls for Fault Isolation in Retinal Diagnostics* (final paper mark: 90%).
Developed a topology-informed framework for measuring acquisition stability and
exploring a fault-isolation heuristic in digital images. Derived a computable
stability bound for the cubical-persistence model and built a parallelised
Python pipeline to test simulated mechanical and radiometric degradations in
retinal images.

[View the public version of the project](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph).
